problem: Existing indoor scene datasets are either small or low-diversity (real scans, procedural), sanitized without small items, riddled with object collisions (designer-made), and lack interactive objects, so they are not simulation-ready with realistic cluttered layouts.
motivation: Embodied agents need large, diverse, simulatable scenes with realistic layouts (many small items, interactive objects) to learn robust skills. Combining real scans, procedural generation and designer scenes under one physics-aware pipeline can supply this.
key_idea: Build a ~40K-scene simulatable indoor dataset (InternScenes) by unifying three sources (real-to-sim replicas of EmbodiedScan, Infinigen procedural scenes, annotated designer scenes), preserving small items, adding articulated PartNet-Mobility objects, and resolving collisions via bbox optimization plus physics simulation.
insight: The benchmarks show that current layout generators (ATISS, DiffuScene, PhyScene) degrade sharply when trained on the full dataset with small objects versus the simplified version (e.g. FID ~100+ vs ~23-30), so cluttered layouts are a real challenge. In navigation, NavDP drops to ~48% SR on Real2Sim and fine-tuning on 118,784 InternScenes trajectories yields only modest gains (48.3→51.0 SR), showing diversity helps but model capacity to exploit scale is open. Failure analysis points to missing collision recovery, embodiment-aware narrow-passage handling, and thin-obstacle perception.
method: Real2Sim replica creation: merge EmbodiedScan regions to ≥8 objects; retrieve Objaverse/PartNet-Mobility assets with GPT-4o/InternVL label mapping and canonical-pose correction; pick candidates by normalized bbox cosine similarity; context-based replacement of ambiguous 'object' labels; mirror L-shaped couches.
Gen subset: extract layouts from Infinigen Indoors constraint-based (simulated-annealing) procedural scenes using object-number-aggressive rules.

Synthetic subset annotation: manual region polygon annotation on BEV maps, human instance split/merge tool, InternVL semantic labeling of 6 rendered views with human verification (87.73% accuracy on 2550 inspected objects).
Bounding-box optimization: L = L_IoU + L_ground + L_reg for large furniture; small objects bound to nearby large furniture.

Physics simulation: COACD convex decomposition (with cavity-aware segmentation) and SAPIEN simulation with gravity/repulsion to remove floating and interpenetration; ~20% objects replaced by PartNet-Mobility articulated assets.
Benchmarks: unconditional layout generation on full vs simplified (45 large-furniture categories) versions; Isaac Sim point-goal navigation with Clearpath Dingo and wheel-speed control.

setting.backbone: Dataset paper; benchmarked ATISS, DiffuScene, PhyScene (layout generation) and DD-PPO, NavDP, NavDP-FT (navigation)
setting.training_data: InternScenes (~40K scenes, 48K regions, 1.96M objects); NavDP fine-tuned on 118,784 generated InternScenes trajectories
setting.observation: Egocentric RGB-D (NavDP) in Isaac Sim; top-down orthographic renders for generation metrics
setting.action_space: Continuous wheel speeds (linear/angular) of a differential-drive Dingo; DD-PPO discrete actions mapped to speeds; NavDP waypoints converted by open-loop controller

numbers.eval_set_note: 20 manually selected InternScenes-Real2Sim scenes, 20 episodes each
numbers.extra: Fine-tuned with 118,784 InternScenes trajectories; Dingo robot in Isaac Sim

numbers.eval_set_note: 10 manually selected InternScenes-Gen scenes, 20 episodes each

numbers_note: Dataset paper; the navigation benchmark is new (own benchmark, baselines' numbers are not the paper's method). Layout generation results (FID/SCA/CKL) are omitted as not navigation numbers. Pretrained NavDP: Real2Sim 48.3/45.3, Gen 61.9/61.8 (baseline, not listed).
results: InternScenes has 39,870 scenes, 48,381 regions, 1.96M objects over 288 classes, averaging 41.5 objects per region. On the navigation benchmark, DD-PPO reaches only 23.6 SR on Real2Sim, NavDP 48.3, and NavDP fine-tuned on InternScenes data 51.0 SR / 49.4 SPL. Layout generators degrade strongly on the full version versus the simplified one.
limitations: Still relies on manual annotation (regions, instances) and could improve scene diversity and asset quality.
Navigation benchmark is small (30 scenes, 20 episodes each) and gain from fine-tuning is modest.
Baseline assets are retrieved replicas, not exact scan geometry; ~12% caption errors in synthetic annotation.
